invariants.text: A product can be searched and filtered by name or description, and the results must include only products that match the search criteria.
All modifications to the database, including order creation, product search, and order cancellation, must be atomic and persisted in a single transaction.
Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each order must be associated with exactly one customer.
Each product in an order must have a valid product_id that exists in the Product table.
Order status must be updated only when the order is successfully cancelled or completed, and cancellation must be explicitly requested.
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderProduct.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderProduct.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
Product stock quantities must remain non-negative after any operation.
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The order date must be set to the current timestamp when an order is created.
The sum of quantities of products in an order must equal the total number of items in that order.
The total quantity of a product across all orders must not exceed its stock quantity at any time.
When an order is cancelled, the stock quantity of each product in the order must be restored to its original value before the order was placed.
